intended_object: The canonical R-algebra embedding R[X] → R[T, T⁻¹] of polynomials into Laurent polynomials, sending X to T (from the docstring and name).
explanation: The body first identifies R[X] with the monoid algebra of ℕ over R (toFinsuppIsoAlg), then moves exponents from ℕ to ℤ along the inclusion ℕ → ℤ (mapDomainAlgHom with Int.ofNatHom). This sends X^n to T^n, which is the standard inclusion. CommSemiring R is the natural assumption, since an R-algebra map between these two R-algebras requires R to be commutative. The plain ring map over any semiring exists separately as Polynomial.toLaurent.
